session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From Open in Bull Trending Trading Range Day' (ET+13 hrs, Jan 21/22; inset Lower Trading Range Or Breakout/Rally?). Small pullback bull trend from open with two legs up into the double top at yesterday's high 6898 (reasonable sell), the wedge second leg down with the failed breakout below the low of day and sell climax at 6842, higher-low double bottoms with buying pressure, the strong breakout then buy-the-close rally to the 6945 buy climax, and the pullback into the 6918 close.
